# Auni

> Auni is an open-source AI agent for a person's own money, which they run on their own computer
> with their own AI login (Claude Code or Codex) and their own wallet. It researches a take they
> have, builds a position for it, and manages it. Every money move is a card they tap to allow,
> unless they turn on Auto for a take, with a dollar budget they set. Nobody operates it: no
> accounts, no fees, no token. MIT licensed, unaudited, use at your own risk.

This is a pnpm monorepo in TypeScript on Node 24, run as one program: `auni` runs its own
Postgres, `apps/core` (the API and the job runner that runs turns, moves and watches) and
`apps/web` (the Next.js app); `packages/shared` holds what both read. Each outside service is one
app folder in `apps/core/src/apps/<id>/`.

## Setting up and using Auni

Helping someone set Auni up? Install it with
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jarrodwatts/auni/main/install.sh | sh` (it builds
from source into `~/.auni/app`), then follow `auni setup --json` until it says stop, as the agent
skill explains. Never ask for a private key, seed phrase or login token, and never read a pairing
link: `auni` opens it in their browser.

- [Agent skill](skills/auni/SKILL.md): installing Auni and setting it up with
  `auni setup --json`, running it, fixing it and changing it (also a Claude Code plugin:
  `.claude-plugin/`)
- [README](README.md): what Auni is and isn't, what keeps the money safe, the commands, and known
  limits
- `auni --help` lists every command and `auni <command> --help` its options. `auni demo` runs the
  whole app with fake money and no login; `auni doctor` says what works and what to fix
- [Settings](apps/core/.env.example): every setting in `~/.auni/.env`

## Contributing and building apps

- [Repo map](AGENTS.md): Auni's words and the checks every change passes; each area's own
  AGENTS.md, beside its code, says the rest
- [Apps](apps/core/src/apps/AGENTS.md): what an app is, its three sizes and its parts, the rules,
  and `pnpm scaffold <id> [--with <parts>]`. Read it first, whatever you add
- Know-how, the smallest app: `pnpm scaffold <id>`, then write its `SKILL.md` (when the agent
  should load it, and the steps that work there). Nothing else is needed
- A reader, so a transaction the agent builds for a service reads as a real card under its name:
  `pnpm scaffold <id> --with reads`, then its `addresses` and `reads`, as
  [KyberSwap's](apps/core/src/apps/kyberswap/reader.ts) are
- A venue, for what a transaction can't do: `pnpm scaffold <id> --with moves,account`, then each
  money tool with its drill, the account, and `problems.ts`, as
  [Aave's](apps/core/src/apps/aave/) are
- A look: `pnpm scaffold <id> --with theme`, then its `theme.css`, which may only give the
  design tokens of `apps/web/app/tokens.css` other values (`apps/core/src/apps/theme.ts`). The
  owner picks it in Settings. None ships yet
- [Venues, readers and jobs for core](apps/core/src/apps/venue.md): a money tool, an account, a
  reader, and the jobs an app does for Auni itself (a swap route, a Solana route, a bridge, a
  pay-in, a token feed), the last four of which also add one line to
  [who is asked first](apps/core/src/apps/order.ts)
- [Lookups](apps/core/src/apps/tools.md): adding read-only tools the agent may call
- [Wallets](apps/core/src/apps/wallet.md): holding the owner's keys and signing
- [Brains](apps/core/src/apps/brain.md): running turns on an AI CLI, locked in a box
- [Watch sources](apps/core/src/apps/source.md): watching the world for the owner's watches
- [Channels](apps/core/src/apps/channel.md): a chat app the owner talks to Auni in, such as
  Telegram
- [Hosts](hosts/README.md): keeping Auni running as a service, in Docker, on Railway or Fly
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): adding an app, the four things it answers for, and pull requests

## Optional

- [Security](SECURITY.md): what counts as a security problem, and how to report one privately
- [What Auni tells its agent](apps/core/src/agent/prompt.ts): the system prompt
- [How Auni works](apps/core/skills/how-auni-works/SKILL.md): the product, as the agent explains it
